text:
maria: :rotating_light: Getting multiple support tickets — hosted inference in eu-west2 (az3) seeing elevated 502/504s and timeouts since ~06:58 UTC. Customers report streams hanging and token billing spikes. First noticed by telemetry: 10-15% 5xx rate on inference gateway.

sam: copying logs now, any immediate repro steps?

maria: quick curl repro from eu-west2-lb: 
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxxx' -d '{"model":"gpt-3x","input":"hello"}'
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"upstream timeout"}
```

jon: running traceroute from edge -> gateway -> model pool, seeing packet loss starting at provider hop 6, intermittent ~6-8% loss and bursts of 200-400ms latency. logs attached.

maria: thanks. any auth or quota noise? some customers also saw auth retries but most are gateway 5xx.

ryan: checked control plane metrics — host agent heartbeats OK, model hosts healthy. This looks like egress path issue toward the public transit provider for az3. Opened ticket with provider AS# 64512, they acknowledge microbursts on a cross-connect. Ticket 2024-RED-892.

alice: can we fail traffic to eu-west1 for affected customers? we have capacity and warm clusters.

sam: recommended immediate mitigations: enable region fallback for affected customer routes, bump routing priority to eu-west1, increase request timeout retries to reduce client-visible 5xx, and temporarily disable bursty autoscale to avoid adding more load to the path.

maria: @deploy-bot can you flip routing policy for the customer tag `cs-eu-az3` to prefer eu-west1 fallback?

deploy-bot: Canary route update started for tag `cs-eu-az3` -> prefer eu-west1. Canary 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% in 5m increments.

jon: while failover runs, I'm pulling pcap from edge and will share indicators for packet duplication/reorder. Also seeing increased TCP retransmits at 06:58:30+.

ryan: provider says they saw a queue saturation event on a specific interconnect and are doing a hardware-level mitigation now. ETA 30-45m for full stabilization per their network ops.

alice: customer comms ready: short note explaining transient network issue in eu-west2, mitigation by routing to eu-west1, no data loss, working on permanent fix. Support to send 15m update once failover completes.

sam: technical followups for postmortem: collect traceroutes, tcpdump, per-hop latency histograms, gateway retry logs, token billing deltas, and any correlation with autoscale events. Also evaluate adding secondary provider peering for az3.

maria: patching temporary routing rule done. Observability shows 5xx rate dropping from 12% -> 3% as traffic shifts to eu-west1. Customers on fallback reporting restored sessions. :thumbsup:

ryan: provider notified our NOC when their mitigation completes. Will confirm when interconnect stable and then we can cut back traffic.

jon: saving tcpdump + traceroute outputs to /mnt/incident/1749999998/ for postmortem.

alice: assigning postmortem owner: @maria. Please include timeline, root cause (provider queue saturation + lacking secondary peering), impact (customers affected, invoices/billing anomalies), and recommended remediations (fallback automation, additional peering, improved SLO runbook).

maria: will draft. support to send 15:30 UTC customer status update. Thanks all.

sam: action items:
- sam: gather logs & billing delta
- jon: pcap + traceroutes
- ryan: follow provider ticket + confirm stabilization
- alice: customer comms & postmortem template
- maria: own postmortem + runbook updates

maria: closing triage thread, will re-open if provider says still unstable. :eyes:
